title: Org-wide switch to read-only fires from ONE click with no confirmation, whenever the user signed in less than 4 minutes ago
evidence: I triggered this on production at 2026-09-04T23:33:04.659233Z and the coordinator confirmed it in the database (user_id 273d686e-…, reason: null). Chain, verified in source: Settings.tsx:644-647 the button 'בקשת סיום שירות' only calls setOffboardingAction('request'); Settings.tsx:883-896 mounts ReauthModal with ONLY open/title/onConfirm/onCancel, so ReauthModal.tsx:134 skipWhenFresh defaults to true; ReauthModal.tsx:151-152 sets fresh when the JWT carries a password amr entry inside FRESH_PASSWORD_WINDOW_SECONDS = 4*60; ReauthModal.tsx:165-167 then fires onConfirm immediately and :195 returns null so THE DIALOG NEVER PAINTS; runOffboardingAction then calls rpc('request_organization_offboarding'). Screenshot out/rtl-a11y/shots/light-desktop/_settings.png shows the resulting panel: 'הבקשה נפתחה ב-04.09.2026, 02:33'. Four minutes later the same loose click matched 'ביטול בקשת הסיום' and cancelled it (23:37:13.312972Z) - two opposite org-wide actions, both one click, the product swapping one button for the other in place.
repro: Sign in with a password. Within 4 minutes go to /settings and click 'בקשת סיום שירות' once. No dialog appears; the organisation is read-only immediately, for 30 days, after which only a platform admin can reactivate.
expected: A destructive, org-wide, time-limited action states its consequence and requires deliberate confirmation. The same file already does this for a far smaller action: revoking one invitation (Settings.tsx:866-875) uses ConfirmDialog with danger and requireReason.
actual: No confirmation of any kind renders between the click and the RPC. Because no reasonLabel is passed either, audit rows are written with reason: null - the audit gap is structural, not a matter of users being careless. Suggested fixes: (a) put a real ConfirmDialog (danger + requireReason, naming the 30-day window) in front of the step-up, or (b) minimally, pass skipWhenFresh={false} for this action.

title: At 390px the payments list drops the invoice-allocation column, the notes and the executed-by column, and there is no way to get them back
evidence: Desktop 1440x900 renders 9 columns (מס׳, ספק, תאריך, סכום, אמצעי, אסמכתא, בוצע על ידי, חשבוניות, הערות). The 390x844 card renders exactly 6 and never the last three. Full page text captured at both widths: out/rtl-a11y/text/desktop/_payments.txt vs out/rtl-a11y/text/mobile/_payments.txt. Twelve figures are on desktop and absent on mobile: 509, 1112376, 2088, 30125, 6633, 7702, 3377, 150, 11390, 11311, 11250, 5731. Payment #4 covers three invoices (11390, 11311, 11250, note 'ריכוז 3 חשבוניות') - the N:M allocation the data model is built around - and on a phone it shows only 'סכום: 1,829.00 ₪'. Notes lost include 'חשבונית 3377 בקיזוז זיכוי 150 ₪', 'תשלום חלקי', 'יתרת חשבונית 7702', 'נוצר מהתאמת תנועת בנק'.
repro: Open /payments at 1440x900, then at 390x844. Compare any row with its card.
expected: The screen's own subtitle promises it: 'צפייה בתשלומים שכבר נרשמו, באסמכתאות שלהם ובחשבוניות שהם כיסו' - and the invoices they covered.
actual: On mobile the invoices they covered are not shown, and cannot be shown. Desktop has an 'עמודות' column chooser (screenshot out/rtl-a11y/kb/02-dialog-open.png shows the equivalent on /invoices); the mobile 'סינון ותצוגה' drawer contains filters only - opening it on /payments added 79 characters and no column options (out/rtl-a11y/drawer.json).

title: At 390px every price loses its unit of measure and its previous price, on the screen whose job is comparing prices
evidence: Desktop columns: מוצר, ספק, יחידה, מחיר נוכחי, מחיר קודם, שינוי, בתוקף מ־, זמינות. Mobile card: product·supplier, availability, מחיר נוכחי, שינוי, בתוקף מ־. Numbers on desktop and absent on mobile: 12.50, 1.23, 1,234.56, 1,250.00, 165.50, 30, 90. Example: desktop 'חסה ערבית | משק ירוק | יחידה | 3.20 ₪ | 12.50 ₪ | -74.4%'; mobile 'חסה ערבית · משק ירוק / מחיר נוכחי: 3.20 ₪ / שינוי: -74.4%'. Reproduced identically as office (out/rtl-a11y/office.log).
repro: Open /prices at both widths and compare any row with its card.
expected: A price is only comparable with its unit. The page describes itself as 'השוואת מחירי הספקים לכל מוצר'.
actual: 3.20 ₪ with no unit, next to 4.60 ₪ which is per ק״ג on desktop - indistinguishable on a phone. The -74.4% change is shown with the base it changed from removed.

evidence: Desktop 1489 chars / mobile 1215. Ten minimum-order amounts present only on desktop: 1,250.00, 350.00, 300.00, 1,000.00, 500.00, 400.00, 250.00, 800.00, 200.00, 150.00. Contact names lost: עופר, מוטי, סיגל אברהם, ברק שלו, דוד ביטון, ג'קי אוחיון, אלון עזרא, רינת בר. Rating (5, 5, 4, 4) and categories lost. Texts: out/rtl-a11y/text/{desktop,mobile}/_suppliers.txt. Dark-theme desktop screenshot showing all columns present: out/rtl-a11y/shots/dark-desktop/_suppliers.png. Identical for office.

title: At 390px the accountant's monthly report loses the entry date and four of the five totals
evidence: Desktop totals row: סה״כ 487.66 ₪ (לפני מע״מ) · 85.34 ₪ (מע״מ) · 573.00 ₪ · 562.00 ₪ (שולם) · 11.00 ₪ (יתרה). Mobile shows only 'סה״כ 573.00 ₪'. 487.66 appears nowhere on the mobile page (out/rtl-a11y/text-diff.json, route /reports, missingNumbers ['02.09.2026','487.66']). The תאריך קליטה column (02.09.2026) is dropped from every invoice card. Texts: out/rtl-a11y/text/{desktop,mobile}/_reports.txt.
repro: Open /reports at both widths and compare the חשבוניות ספטמבר 2026 table with its mobile cards.
expected: This is the monthly package for the accountant; the pre-VAT total and the entry date (which decides an invoice's month) are load-bearing.
actual: Only the gross total survives. The KPI tiles above recover 573.00 and 85.34 but not 487.66, 562.00 or 11.00.

title: In dark mode the page description on every screen measures 3.07-3.95:1 against the background actually painted under it (AA needs 4.5)
evidence: Rendered-pixel measurement, 1112 text nodes, out/rtl-a11y/contrast-dark-desktop.json. text-ink-muted oklch(0.68 0.01 80): /settings 3.07, /alerts 3.27, /reports 3.31, /orders 3.31, /suppliers 3.31, /prices 3.31, /inventory 3.31, /invoices 3.31, /payments 3.31, /bank 3.48, /analytics 3.52, /exceptions 3.52, /dashboard 3.71, /bank 12px 3.95, /documents 4.37. text-ink-soft 4.41 on /reports and /documents. The failures never sit on the dark canvas #011519 - they sit on #263639..#3e4d4e, a band the ambient glow lightens, and the exact hex varies per route with the radial's position (out/rtl-a11y/glow grouping in the run log).
repro: Switch to dark mode, open any list screen, measure the subtitle under the h1 against the pixels behind it.
expected: PRODUCT.md:72 states the target: WCAG 2.1 AA, text >= 4.5:1. DESIGN.md caps the glow at 17% alpha on the strength of a measured table - 15% -> 4.73, 17% -> 4.60, 18% -> 4.47 fails - for ink-muted on the canvas.
actual: That table was measured in the light palette only. In dark the same overlay lightens the header band instead, and costs ink-muted 0.6-1.4 points, putting the description line below AA on every screen. ink-muted on the un-lightened dark canvas still passes, so the token is not the problem - the untested interaction between the glow and the dark palette is.

title: The mandated '—' no-data marker is painted in the token DESIGN.md reserves for decoration, at 1.9:1 light and 2.4:1 dark
evidence: text-ink-ghost oklch(0.755 0.014 80) on the light canvas #fffcf8 and on the dark canvas #011519 = 2.4:1 measured (out/rtl-a11y/contrast-dark-desktop.json). It is the only surviving light-theme failure of 1216 nodes measured. text-ink-faint '—' measures 4.37:1 in dark. Visible in out/rtl-a11y/shots/dark-desktop/_suppliers.png: the dashes in קטגוריות / התראות / מינ׳ הזמנה / יתרה פתוחה are barely distinguishable from the background.
repro: Open /suppliers in either theme and look at a cell with no value.
expected: CLAUDE.md: 'מדד שאין לו נתונים מציג — , לא 0 — אפס הוא גם טענה על המציאות.' The dash is a deliberate assertion about reality, so it is content and needs 4.5:1. DESIGN.md defines ink-ghost as 'אייקונים כבויים, סימנים דקורטיביים'.
actual: A meaningful assertion is drawn in the decorative token. Below 3:1, i.e. it would fail even the large-text threshold.

title: A file name containing Hebrew renders with its number and extension reordered: '93_00002007 — חלק 3.pdf' is shown as 'pdf.3 חלק — 00002007_93'
evidence: Measured by per-character geometry, not by reading the DOM string: logical '93_00002007 — חלק 3.pdf', glyphs sorted by screen x = 'pdf.3קלח—00002007_93' (out/rtl-a11y/rtlvisual.log). Cropped and viewed: out/rtl-a11y/rtl/03-documents-hebrew-filename.png. The same list renders the Latin-only '93_00002007.pdf' correctly (out/rtl-a11y/rtl/04-documents-latin-filename.png). Element is <bdi>, computed direction rtl, unicode-bidi isolate, no dir attribute, no embedded control characters. Confirms a lead raised by another agent this round.
repro: Open /documents and look at any file whose name mixes digits, an em dash and Hebrew.
expected: The name shown is the name of the file.
actual: <bdi> isolates the name from the surrounding sentence but resolves the name's OWN direction from its first strong character. Digits are not strong, so the first strong character here is Hebrew, direction resolves RTL, and the Latin/numeric segments inside are reordered. src/lib/fileNameIsolation.spec.ts is honest that it is 'a source scan, not a rendering', and its three sanctioned forms (<bdi>, bidiIsolate(), dir="auto") all resolve direction the same way - so a name that STARTS with Latin (its own worked example, 'invoice-2026-08 סופי.pdf') is fixed while a name starting with digits is not. DESIGN.md's own tech-id rule already prescribes the answer: 'תמיד isolate ובדרך כלל dir=ltr' - only the first half is applied.

title: The column-chooser announces role=dialog but does not contain focus and does not return it on Escape
evidence: out/rtl-a11y/keyboard.json: opening it with Enter gives hasDialog true, aria-modal null, focus moves inside. Of 14 subsequent Tab presses, 7 landed outside the dialog. After Escape, focus was on 'פעולות עבור חשבונית QA-R3-1112376' - a row-action button in the table behind - not on the 'עמודות' trigger. Screenshot out/rtl-a11y/kb/02-dialog-open.png.
repro: Tab to 'עמודות' on /invoices, press Enter, then Tab repeatedly, then Escape.
expected: Either it is a modal dialog (contain focus, aria-modal=true) or a non-modal popover - but in both cases Escape returns focus to the control that opened it.
actual: It claims to be a dialog to assistive technology while behaving as neither, and a keyboard user who closes it is dropped somewhere else on the page.

title: The shekel sign sits on opposite sides of the figure in two places on the same screen
evidence: Geometry over 184 rendered ₪ occurrences: 175 place the symbol left of the digits, 9 place it right (out/rtl-a11y/bidi.json). The 9 are all .kpi-hero, which computes direction: ltr while every other figure computes rtl - identical source string. Crops viewed: out/rtl-a11y/rtl/01-dashboard-kpi-hero-row.png shows '68,663₪', '1,724₪', '10,942₪'; out/rtl-a11y/rtl/02-dashboard-non-hero-shekel.png shows '₪ 573' on the same page. $ was consistent in all 3 occurrences found.
repro: Open /dashboard and compare a hero KPI tile with the 'החודש' figure lower down.
expected: CLAUDE.md keeps one source of truth for money shape (check:money).
actual: Two shapes on one screen. Note: this partially diverges from the lead I was given - I did not find ₪ and $ on opposite sides within one tile; I found ₪ inconsistent between kpi-hero and everything else.

title: The alerts field on the mobile supplier card has no label, unlike every other field on it
evidence: out/rtl-a11y/text/mobile/_suppliers.txt: every field is 'טלפון:', 'יתרה פתוחה:' etc, but the alerts value appears bare - a naked '—' between 'טלפון: 026518868' and 'יתרה פתוחה:', or a naked '1 חריג / 1 זיכוי' with nothing saying what it is.
expected: Each value on the card names itself, as the others do.
actual: An orphan value; for a screen-reader user it is a number with no field name.

title: The monthly bar chart shows four bars and three axis labels at 390px
evidence: Desktop axis: יוני 2026, יולי 2026, אוגוסט 2026, ספטמבר 2026. Mobile axis: יוני 2026, יולי 2026, ספטמבר 2026 (out/rtl-a11y/text/{desktop,mobile}/_dashboard.txt). The KPI immediately beside it reads 'מול אוגוסט 2026', which is the label that was dropped. The 8-week line chart also thins from 7 ticks to 4, which is ordinary responsive tick culling on a continuous axis and is not reported.
repro: Open /dashboard at 390x844 and look at 'הוצאות רכש לפי חודש'.
expected: A categorical bar chart labels its bars, or says which are unlabelled.
actual: One of four category labels is culled, so the bars can be misread by one position.
